parsed.diagnosis: Policy isolates a mildly degraded friction wheel that remains usable, leaving a more degraded wheel in control. Attitude error then trips SAFE, followed by minimum-dwell resume to NOMINAL with the same degraded 3-wheel allocation. Rapid SAFE-NOMINAL cycling pumps momentum and attitude error to violation, while 4-wheel no-policy control rides through.
parsed.rationale: Increase minimum SAFE dwell 600s to 900s to keep sun-point and charging longer. Delays re-exposure to demanding NOMINAL pointing on 3 wheels, breaks rapid 600s resume cycling seen in logs, lets attitude settle and SoC charge higher before resume, and can push late wheel saturations beyond the 2-orbit horizon. Fixes a few cycling cases conservatively.
parsed.why_no_regressions: Only delays SAFE to NOMINAL resume, adds no new isolations or SAFE entries. Longer SAFE is power-positive sun-point, far from SoC 0.20 and attitude limits. Single-fault runs still resume 300s later within sim with no new violation.
